description.message: Fills in your TikTok and Instagram upload for the free SharkyClips app. You check it and click Post yourself.

pair_howto.message: In SharkyClips, open Settings, then the Helper guide, and click "Show connection code". Type the code here.

pair_wrong.message: That code didn't work. Show a new code in SharkyClips and try again.

state_ok.message: Connected to SharkyClips on this PC.

state_no_app.message: SharkyClips isn't running on this PC. Start it and try again.

about.message: The Helper only runs on TikTok and Instagram pages and only talks to SharkyClips on this PC. It never clicks Post.

pair_banner_sub.message: Click the Helper's icon in the toolbar and type the code SharkyClips shows you.
